PROP-e5782b58-pre-020.text: Admin aggregate view must verify is_admin before returning cross-user attendance data.

PROP-e5782b58-inv-018.text: New user registration must set role/permission_level to 0 (regular member), never admin by default.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-018.assertion: forall completeRegistration: new_user.permission_level == 0 AND new_user.is_admin == false

PROP-e5782b58-asm-008.text: Supabase Realtime subscriptions must enforce RLS; unauthenticated clients must not receive events.
PROP-e5782b58-asm-008.assertion: forall realtime_subscription: RLS policies applied to broadcast events

PROP-e5782b58-inv-019.text: Temp_registration creation must be rate-limited per kiosk to prevent token flooding attacks.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-019.assertion: forall createTempRegistration from kiosk k: rate(k) <= max_reg_per_hour

PROP-0000-create-pre-001.text: Authenticated users must not modify is_admin column via self-update RLS policy.
PROP-0000-create-pre-001.assertion: forall u: authenticated_update(members, u) => u.is_admin == old(u.is_admin)

PROP-0000-create-inv-001.text: Members UPDATE RLS policy must include WITH CHECK restricting writable columns.
PROP-0000-create-inv-001.assertion: policy(members, authenticated, UPDATE).with_check != true AND restricts_columns(policy, [is_admin, status, generation])

PROP-0000-create-pre-002.text: record_attendance_by_card must validate card_id format before database lookup.
PROP-0000-create-pre-002.assertion: forall call: record_attendance_by_card(p_card_id) => is_valid_card_format(p_card_id) OR return(success=false)

PROP-0000-create-inv-002.text: record_attendance_by_card must enforce rate limiting per card_id to prevent replay abuse.
PROP-0000-create-inv-002.assertion: forall c, t1, t2: attendance(c, t1) AND attendance(c, t2) AND t1 != t2 => abs(t2 - t1) > MIN_INTERVAL

PROP-0000-create-inv-003.text: temp_registrations qr_token must not be readable by anon role to prevent token theft.
PROP-0000-create-inv-003.assertion: policy(temp_registrations, anon, SELECT).columns NOT INCLUDES qr_token OR policy restricts expired rows

PROP-0000-create-pre-003.text: temp_registrations must enforce single-use: is_used=true tokens must not be reusable.
PROP-0000-create-pre-003.assertion: forall t: use_registration(t) => t.is_used == false AND t.expires_at > now()

PROP-0000-create-inv-004.text: SECURITY DEFINER function search_path must be explicitly set to prevent search_path injection.

PROP-0000-create-inv-005.text: attendance.attendances type column must be constrained to valid values ('in', 'out').
PROP-0000-create-inv-005.assertion: forall a in attendances: a.type IN ('in', 'out')

PROP-0000-create-inv-006.text: Attendance toggle must check date boundary: last record from previous day resets to 'in'.
PROP-0000-create-inv-006.assertion: forall card, today: last_attendance(card).date != today => new_type(card) == 'in'

PROP-0000-create-inv-007.text: RLS must be FORCE-enabled on all member and attendance tables to prevent owner bypass.
PROP-0000-create-inv-007.assertion: forall t in [member.*, attendance.*]: rls_forced(t) == true

PROP-0000-create-inv-008.text: anon role must have no direct table access on member schema after security fix migration.
PROP-0000-create-inv-008.assertion: forall t in member.*: has_privilege(anon, t, ANY) == false

PROP-0000-create-asm-001.text: auth.uid() in RLS policies correctly returns the authenticated user's UUID from JWT.

PROP-0000-create-asm-002.text: card_id UNIQUE constraint prevents one card being linked to multiple users.
PROP-0000-create-asm-002.assertion: forall c: count(attendance.users WHERE card_id = c) <= 1

PROP-0000-create-inv-009.text: authenticated users must only read their own attendance records (auth.uid() = user_id).
PROP-0000-create-inv-009.assertion: forall req, row: policy(attendances, authenticated, SELECT) => row.user_id == auth.uid()

PROP-0000-create-inv-010.text: team_leaders and generation_roles tables must be inaccessible to authenticated and anon roles.
PROP-0000-create-inv-010.assertion: forall r in [authenticated, anon]: has_policy(team_leaders, r, ANY) == false AND has_policy(generation_roles, r, SELECT) only

PROP-0000-create-pre-004.text: record_attendance_by_card must reject NULL or empty string card_id without exception.
PROP-0000-create-pre-004.assertion: forall p: record_attendance_by_card(p) AND (p IS NULL OR p = '') => return(success=false)

PROP-0000-create-inv-011.text: EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS in RPC must not leak internal error details to anon callers.
PROP-0000-create-inv-011.assertion: forall err: catch_all_handler(record_attendance_by_card) => response NOT CONTAINS (table_name, column_name, stack_trace)

PROP-0000-create-inv-012.text: anon must not have INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on temp_registrations after security fix.
PROP-0000-create-inv-012.assertion: has_privilege(anon, temp_registrations, INSERT) == false AND has_privilege(anon, temp_registrations, UPDATE) == false AND has_privilege(anon, temp_registrations, DELETE) == false

PROP-0000-create-post-001.text: After attendance insert, returned JSON type must match the inserted record type.

PROP-0000-create-inv-014.text: temp_registrations expired tokens must not be usable for card registration.
PROP-0000-create-inv-014.assertion: forall t: use_token(t) => t.expires_at > now() AND t.is_used == false

PROP-0000-create-pre-005.text: attendance.users card_id must be normalized before storage to prevent case/encoding bypass.
PROP-0000-create-pre-005.assertion: forall c: store_card_id(c) => c == normalize(c) (lowercase, trim, no special chars)

PROP-0000-create-inv-015.text: Default privileges must not grant ALL to anon on attendance schema objects.
PROP-0000-create-inv-015.assertion: default_privileges(attendance, anon, TABLES) == NONE AND default_privileges(attendance, anon, FUNCTIONS) == NONE

PROP-0000-create-inv-016.text: authenticated users can read all attendance.users records including card_id; verify no PII leak.
PROP-0000-create-inv-016.assertion: policy(attendance.users, authenticated, SELECT).using == true => card_id is not sensitive_PII

PROP-0000-create-asm-004.text: Only service_role can invoke admin operations; no authenticated bypass path exists.
PROP-0000-create-asm-004.assertion: forall op in admin_ops: requires_role(op, service_role) AND NOT callable_by(op, authenticated)

PROP-0000-create-post-002.text: get_daily_attendance_counts must not return data outside requested date range.
PROP-0000-create-post-002.assertion: forall r in result: r.date >= start_date AND r.date <= end_date

PROP-0000-create-inv-017.text: get_daily_attendance_details must exclude soft-deleted members (deleted_at IS NOT NULL).
PROP-0000-create-inv-017.assertion: forall r in result: member(r.user_id).deleted_at IS NULL

PROP-0000-create-pre-006.text: record_attendance_by_card must not be vulnerable to SQL injection via p_card_id parameter.
PROP-0000-create-pre-006.assertion: forall input: record_attendance_by_card(input) => parameterized_query(input) AND no_string_concat(input)

PROP-0000-create-inv-019.text: Concurrent card swipes must not create duplicate attendance records (race condition).
PROP-0000-create-inv-019.assertion: forall c, t: concurrent_calls(record_attendance_by_card, c) => serialized_insert(c) (no duplicate timestamp+user)
